antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 870nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in astrocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Mid-infrared 8.3um: water channel modulation at 36 THz, pulsed 10^-12s, 10min cycles targeting neuron_mitochondria in astrocyte. Study reference: 2025 peer-reviewed paper shows neuroprotection at 870nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial complex_IV_cytochrome_c_oxidase activation.
